capabilities: Export subscriptions, playlists, Watch Later, and liked lists to Markdown notes
Sync data through the YouTube Data API v3 with user-supplied OAuth credentials
Track removed and unavailable videos across syncs
Download or link channel avatars, banners, and video thumbnails
Render dashboard and per-note views driven by Dataview
extras: Desktop only (OAuth loopback redirect); users must create their own Google Cloud OAuth client; manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The author built it because YouTube accounts get terminated and videos disappear without notice, while an Obsidian vault is local and under the user's control.
problem: YouTube accounts get terminated, playlists get emptied, and videos disappear without notice, and YouTube offers no durable local export of that data.

relations.evidence: It needs the community Dataview plugin.
opens the playlists page in Obsidian's built-in Web viewer core plugin

requires.name: Own Google Cloud OAuth client ID and secret

summary: Backs up YouTube subscriptions, playlists, Watch Later, and liked lists into Dataview-queryable Markdown notes in the vault.
